\newcommand{\SwtLengthQuantumPolicy}{the pitch and the four radial variables (chamber\_outer\_radius\_m, dielectric\_thickness\_m, radial\_clearance\_m, magnet\_radial\_thickness\_m) and the requested exit radius are represented by their nearest multiple of 2^-40 m (0.91 pm) before the sweep-v2 rules are applied, so every radial sum and stage-centre product is exact in binary64 and the geometry v1.1 ULP identities hold with zero error; the sweep-v2 inward-ULP walks are kept as verification and return at their first iteration. Reason (found on the raw Sobol sample before the shakedown): 22 of 128 raw value sets violate (r\_w + d) - r\_w == d within 2 ULP purely by rounding once r\_w + d exceeds 2^-8 m, which no exit-radius walk can repair; requested and represented values are both recorded}
\newcommand{\SwtKochCitation}{Koch, N., Harmann, H.-P., Kornfeld, G., Status of the THALES High Efficiency Multi Stage Plasma Thruster Development for HEMP-T 3050 and HEMP-T 30250, IEPC-2007-110 (2007), Table 1 (rho = 1.53 / 1.70 / 3.07 for DM9-1 and 4.07 / 4.2 / 10.57 for DM10); Koch et al., The HEMPT Concept - A Survey on Theoretical Considerations and Experimental Evidences, IEPC-2011-236 (2011)}
\newcommand{\SwtRhoConservativeDefinition}{|B|(r\_w, z\_c) / max(upstream axis peak, downstream axis peak) - the binding HEMP-like classifier}
\newcommand{\SwtRhoWallDefinition}{|B|(r\_w, z\_c) / max |B|(r\_w, z) over the two wall cells adjacent to the cusp - the 'cusp is the wall maximum' reading; PPM fundamental-only prediction I\_1(x\_w) / I\_0(x\_w) < 1 for every x\_w}
\newcommand{\SwtHempLikeRule}{a design is HEMP-like iff it has at least one wall cusp inside the straight dielectric and every such cusp has rho\_conservative >= 1.5 (the lower end of the DM9-1 anode cusp value 1.53 in Koch's Table 1, rounded)}
\newcommand{\SwtRhoThreshold}{1.5}
\newcommand{\SwtPpmStatement}{for an infinite single-harmonic PPM stack of pitch L, wall radius r\_w, x\_w = pi r\_w / L: |B|(r\_w, z\_c) / b\_1 = I\_1(x\_w); |B|(r\_w, z\_c) / |B|(r\_w, stage centre) = I\_1(x\_w) / I\_0(x\_w); review section 2.2}
\newcommand{\SwtPpmWhyNotRealised}{the realised rho divides by the finite-stack axis peak (end effects raise the interior peak above the fitted b\_1 by a few percent) and the L1a field has small end-effect harmonics, so rho / I\_1(x\_w) was 0.88-0.94 for the four sweep-v2 representatives and P2 in the review's Table D}

\newcommand{\SwtRwOverLStar}{0.616668}
\newcommand{\SwtXStarTwo}{1.94}
\newcommand{\SwtRwOverLStarThree}{0.617}
\newcommand{\SwtHypothesisStatement}{H1: over every wall cusp of the 128 Sobol designs, rho\_conservative tracks the PPM prediction I\_1(x\_w): the least-squares slope of rho on I\_1(x\_w) through the origin lies in [0.80, 1.00] and at least 80 \% of the cusps have rho\_conservative / I\_1(x\_w) within the agreement band. H2: the I\_1 threshold predicts the HEMP-like classification: a design with x\_w >= x* = 1.937318 (I\_1(x\_w) >= 1.5) is HEMP-like and a design with x\_w < x* is not, with prediction accuracy >= 0.85 over the Sobol designs that have at least one wall cusp. Both are REPORTED tests, not binding gates; the numbers are what the campaign measures.}
\newcommand{\SwtHypothesisFalsifier}{slope outside [0.80, 1.00], fewer than 80 \% of cusps in the band, accuracy below 0.85, or HEMP-like designs appearing inside the sweep-v2 box}
